meta.name: The Frozen Wastes
meta.description: An ice-age world of glacial caves and mammoth bones. Survive the cold, the beasts, and the thing entombed in the glacier.
meta.author: Creator Skill

gmPrompt: You are the GM for a gritty ice-age survival crawler. You are generous and story-first — if a player's idea makes for a good moment, you let it happen. You care more about whether an action is interesting than whether it's strictly realistic. Improvised weapons, desperate gambits, and creative uses of primitive gear should be rewarded. Narrate outcomes with the raw, physical language of survival — cold, hunger, exhaustion, and the primal satisfaction of outsmarting something that wants to eat you.

monsters.name: Ice Mite Swarm
monsters.special: Immune to single-target attacks. Area effects deal double damage.

monsters.name: Frost Wraith
monsters.special: Ignores armor. On critical damage, target loses d4 DEX from frostbite.

monsters.name: Woolly Mammoth
monsters.special: On critical damage, target is knocked prone and loses next action.

monsters.name: Ice Troll
monsters.special: Recovers 2 HP per round unless burned.

monsters.name: The Glacier King
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or is frozen in place for one round.

black_ice: The floor is slick with black ice, nearly invisible.
Your feet slide on frozen stone. Every step is a gamble.
A sheet of dark ice covers everything — one wrong step and you're down.
bones: Bones are heaped against the walls, cracked and gnawed.
Old bones crunch underfoot. Some of them are enormous.
A tangle of ribs and tusks blocks the way forward.
narrow_gap: The passage narrows to a crack barely wide enough to squeeze through.
Walls of ice press in from both sides.
You have to turn sideways and force yourself through.
ice_bridge: A thin arch of ice spans the gap. It groans under its own weight.
The bridge is translucent — you can see the drop through it.
Cracks web across the surface. It won't hold forever.
carcasses: Half-eaten carcasses are scattered across the floor.
Something has been feeding here. The kills are fresh.
Bones and frozen meat are piled in a rough nest.

cracking: The ice cracks somewhere deep below — a sound like a breaking spine.
Sharp pops echo through the passage. The glacier is shifting.
A long, slow crack runs through the silence.
dripping: Meltwater drips from above in a steady rhythm.
Each drop echoes off the ice walls.
Water trickles down the walls, pooling at your feet.
gnawing: Something is gnawing on bone nearby.
Wet, crunching sounds come from the dark ahead.
Teeth on bone. Close. Getting closer.
groaning: The glacier groans like a living thing.
Deep, resonant sounds vibrate through the ice.
The walls shift and moan. Nothing here is stable.
rushing_water: Water roars beneath the ice, fast and black.
You can hear a river running under your feet.
The sound of rushing water fills the chamber.
wailing: A high, keening wail echoes from ahead.
The wind — or something else — screams through the tunnels.
A sound like a voice, frozen mid-cry, reverberates off the walls.
heartbeat: A low throb pulses through the ice. Rhythmic. Patient.
You feel it before you hear it — a heartbeat in the glacier.
Something is alive in the ice. Something old.

grey_sky: Pale grey light filters in from the surface.
The last of the daylight reaches this far, thin and cold.
Above, the sky is the color of old bone.
refracted: Light bends through the ice in strange, shifting patterns.
Prismatic colors dance across the frozen walls.
The ice refracts your torchlight into a dozen false paths.
embers: A faint orange glow pulses from dying coals.
Someone's fire, long abandoned. The embers still breathe.
Charred wood and the ghost of warmth.
phosphorescence: The ice itself glows with a faint, sickly light.
Something luminous is frozen in the walls.
A cold blue-green light pulses from deep in the glacier.
steam_glow: Steam rises in thick curtains, lit from below.
Warm light glows through the mist.
The steam catches the light and turns everything soft.
blue_deep: A deep blue light radiates from the ice, ancient and cold.
The walls glow with the blue of glacial depths.
Everything is bathed in the cold blue light of deep ice.

rot: The stench of decay cuts through the cold.
Something dead. The cold has only slowed the rot.
A thick, sweet reek hangs in the still air.
smoke: Old smoke lingers here. Someone burned something.
The air tastes of ash and charred fat.
A faint haze of smoke clings to the ceiling.
musk: A heavy animal musk fills the space.
The rank smell of a predator's den.
Fur and urine. Something lives here.
sulfur: The sharp bite of sulfur stings your nostrils.
Rotten-egg stench rises with the steam.
The water smells of deep earth and brimstone.
ancient: The air smells of nothing. Just cold and stone and time.
A dry, mineral smell — the breath of the glacier itself.
This place smells old. Older than memory.
blood: Iron and copper. The smell of fresh blood.
Dark stains on the ice. The smell is unmistakable.
Blood has been spilled here. Recently.

freezing: The cold here is savage. It bites through everything.
Your breath freezes before it leaves your lips.
The temperature drops sharply. Your fingers go numb.
wind: Wind howls across the entrance, carrying ice crystals.
A bitter gust tears at your clothes.
howling: The wind channels through the tunnels in a constant scream.
You can barely hear yourself think over the howling.
The passage amplifies every gust into a roar.
eerie: Something feels wrong here. Too quiet. Too still.
The air has a weight to it, like being watched.
Your instincts say leave. Your path says forward.
warmth: Heat radiates from somewhere below. Almost comfortable.
The air is warm and damp — a shock after the cold.
For the first time in hours, you stop shivering.
vertigo: The drop below is bottomless. Don't look down.
The scale of this place makes you dizzy.
Your stomach lurches. The void pulls at you.
sacred: A stillness here that feels deliberate. Intentional.
Something about this place demands reverence.
The air itself feels heavy with meaning.
dread: Every instinct screams at you to turn back.
The cold here isn't natural. It has intent.
